issue: No edit capability for existing listings

issue: Protected pages render a blank page for signed-out users instead of a sign-in prompt or redirect
actual: Good cases: logged-out "Add to Cart" redirected to /login with toast "Please log in to add items to your cart"; "Message Seller" dialog showed a "Log in to message" button; Sell/cart controls hidden. But visiting /cart, /create-listing and /my-listings while signed out renders a completely empty page (document.body.innerText === "" after 1.2 s) — no sign-in prompt, no redirect, no message.

issue: Seller has no way to view received purchase requests / buyer messages
actual: Bella Buyer sent a message request ("Hi Tim, I would like to buy the crate nightstand...") on Tim's listing and also submitted a cart purchase request (toast "Purchase requests sent to sellers!", cart emptied). Signing back in as the seller Tim Tester, My Listings shows only the listing card (View/Mark Sold/Delete) with no requests section, the owned product page shows only "Manage Your Listings", the header has no inbox, and the "My Profile" menu item leads to a 404 page. No requested item or buyer message is viewable anywhere, so the cart request being reported as "sent" cannot be corroborated by any recorded request.
